evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The suite is granted authority to assign a role (reviewer) to a person based on an action — a hierarchical allocation enacted by an automated principal.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: The memory is framed as a vehicle for the enrollment rule, reinforcing the authority-ranking move by subordinating the memory's purpose to carrying the allocation assertion.

mints.name: AutomatedRoleEnrollment
mints.title: the suite enrolls its creator as a reviewer
mints.frame: Is a system or rule assigning a role or status to a person based on an action they performed, and is that allocation being asserted as governing?
